fact: Countdown to 2030's data quality table for Namibia's DHIS2 gives 96 per cent of expected monthly facility reports received nationally in 2024, up from 86 per cent in 2019, with 93 per cent of districts at 90 per cent completeness or more; it is reporting completeness, not a count of clinics entering their own data.
title: Namibia Analysis Report 2025: Analysis of Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn, Child and Adolescent Health Indicators for 2019-2024: Synthesis Report
